memo_relation records (where the memo is source or target), then attachments linked to the memo

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` deletes those first, then calls the dialect `DeleteMemo`, which only removes the `memo` row (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`). The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` deletes comment memos before that; it does not delete reactions or shares in the store layer.
